voiceSummary: Capri Global Capital Limited has intimated the schedule for analyst and institutional investor meetings under SEBI Listing Regulations. Interactions will occur via virtual or in-person modes from November 13, 2026, to December 1, 2026. Meetings in India are scheduled for November 13, 2026, November 18 to 20, 2026, and November 23 to 27, 2026. International meetings in Singapore, Hong Kong, US, and UK are set for November 23 to 27, 2026, and November 30 to December 1, 2026. The schedule is subject to change based on market conditions. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared. Investor presentations will be uploaded to www.capriloans.in and filed with stock exchanges before the interactions begin.

attchmntText: KPI Green Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about  revision in time of Analysts/ Investors Earnings Conference Call. The Conference Call will now be held on Friday, November 13, 2026, at 04:30 PM.
voiceSummary: KPI Green Energy Limited has revised the timing of its conference call with investors and analysts. The call, scheduled for Friday, November 13, 2026, to discuss unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, will now commence at 4:30 P.M. IST. This is a change from the previously announced time of 02:30 P.M. IST. The event will feature Whole Time Director Moh. Sohil Yusufbhai Dabhoya, Executive Director Rajesh Shrivastava, Group CFO Kapil Kriplani, and CEO BESS Erez Schreiber. Registration details and dial-in numbers are provided via Ernst & Young LLP. All other details from the earlier intimation dated November 07, 2026, remain unchanged. The revised invite is hosted on the company website.

voiceSummary: Fusion CX Limited will announce financial results for the second quarter of FY27 ended September 30, 2026 on Friday, 13th November 2026. An earnings conference call will be held on Monday, 16th November 2026 at 4:00 PM IST. The call will discuss the financial results and will be conducted via audio conference. Management representatives including Chairman and CEO Mr. Pankaj Dhanuka, COO Mr. Kishore Saraogi, CFO Mr. Amit Soni, and CMO Mr. Manish Jain will participate. The schedule is subject to change. Results will be available on the company website.

attchmntText: K.P. Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about revision in time of Analysts/ Investors Earnings Conference Call. The Conference Call will now be held on on Friday, November 13, 2026, at 02:30 PM.
voiceSummary: K.P. Energy Limited has revised the timing of its Analyst and Investor Earnings Conference Call. The call, scheduled for Friday, November 13, 2026, to discuss unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, will now commence at 2:30 P.M. IST. This is a change from the previously announced time of 4:30 P.M. IST. The event was originally intimated on November 7, 2026. The revision was communicated via a notice dated November 10, 2026. All other details regarding the conference call remain unchanged. The revised invite is available on the company website at www.kpenergy.in. The conference call will feature Mr. Affan Faruk Patel, Mr. Rajesh Shrivastava, Mr. Kapil Kriplani, and Ms. Shabana Belim.

attchmntText: Sunteck Realty Limited has informed the Exchange about Completion of tenure of Mr. V P Shetty (DIN: 00021773) as an Independent Director
voiceSummary: Sunteck Realty Limited intimates that the term of Mr. Vaddarse Prabhakar Shetty, DIN 00021773, as an Independent Director has concluded with effect from the close of business hours on 10th November, 2026. Consequently, he ceases to hold the position of Independent Director of the Company. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The Company requests the exchanges to take the above on record.

attchmntText: Aegis Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Aegis Logistics Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 03, 2026. The company announced a definitive agreement dated October 13, 2026, to acquire an 89.8% stake in Tristar Holdings Limited for US$809 million, pending regulatory approvals and expected to close in Q4 FY27. For H1 FY27, Aegis reported revenue of INR4,570 crores, EBITDA of INR1,184 crores, and profit after tax of INR866 crores. EPS for the half-year was INR21.23. For Q2 FY27, revenue was INR2,213 crores, EBITDA INR456 crores, and PAT INR321 crores. Aegis Vopak Terminals reported Q2 revenue of INR271 crores and EBITDA of INR212 crores. Expansion projects include a 64,000 cubic meter liquid storage facility at Mumbai, an LPG bottling plant at JNPT, and a 94,148 cubic meter CRL-4 terminal at Kandla. An ammonia terminal at Pipavav was commissioned with a 15-year agreement with Hindustan Zinc and a 10% stake acquired by ITOCHU Corporation.

attchmntText: Rentomojo Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Rentomojo Limited approved unaudited financial results for Q2 FY 2026-27 ending September 30, 2026. Standalone revenue was Rs. 1,421.13 million, with a net profit of Rs. 181.93 million. Basic earnings per share stood at Rs. 1.84. The Board also approved remuneration revisions for Executive Director Ketan Krishna, DIN 09032220, and other Key Managerial Persons, effective April 1, 2026. Designation changes were approved for Rohan Ajeet Kulkarni and Prabhat Verma, effective November 10, 2026. CRISIL Ratings Limited confirmed no deviation in the utilization of issue proceeds for the quarter. The Board meeting concluded at 7:31 P.M. on November 10, 2026.

attchmntText: HCL Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Release-  HCLTech and PTC collaborate to accelerate semiconductor product lifecycle management '.
voiceSummary: HCL Technologies Ltd. has announced a collaboration with PTC to accelerate semiconductor product lifecycle management. The partnership involves launching a pre-configured semiconductor Product Lifecycle Management solution built on the PTC Windchill platform. This solution aims to streamline product development, strengthen quality and compliance, and reduce operational complexity. It connects people, processes, and data across the semiconductor lifecycle, including IP management, new product introduction, supplier collaboration, and regulatory compliance. The solution integrates with existing business, manufacturing, and design systems for end-to-end visibility. HCLTech and PTC stated that the collaboration helps customers modernize product development and management at scale. The announcement was filed with the BSE and NSE on November 10, 2026.

attchmntText: Aegis Vopak Terminals Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Aegis Vopak Terminals Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 03, 2026. Chairman Raj Chandaria announced a definitive agreement dated October 13, 2026, to acquire an 89.8% stake in Tristar Holdings Limited for US$809 million. The transaction is subject to regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions, with completion expected in Q4 of FY27. For the first half of FY27, Aegis Logistics reported revenue of INR4,570 crores, EBITDA of INR1,184 crores, and profit after tax of INR866 crores. Earnings per share for the half-year was INR21.23. For the second quarter, revenue was INR2,213 crores, EBITDA was INR456 crores, and profit after tax was INR321 crores. Aegis Vopak Terminals reported Q2 revenue of INR271 crores and EBITDA of INR212 crores. The company highlighted expansion projects at JNPT, Kandla, and Pipavav, including the commissioning of an ammonia terminal at Pipavav with a 10% stake acquired by ITOCHU Corporation.
